items.q: So Jesse Price agreed -- Moe Gale must've made him a good offer and he agreed to join the band when we got there.

ctx.x: Yeah. He was teaching there. So Jesse Price agreed -- Moe Gale must've made him a good offer and he agreed to join the band when we got there.
And we didn't rehearse with him. He just came down to the date that we played in Kansas City.
